purpose: Locked information-safe tests of below-target, exact-target, already-overshot, and unreachable bid strategy.

trainingPolicy.note: Never use any locked state or seat rotation in training.

scenarios.title: 3p below bid win: choose any equally safe strategically correct trick result

source.note: Real public/own-hand match position; only the acting player's public prediction is changed to expose each requested regime.

reasonableActionRule.note: Accept every publicly guaranteed move with the requested trick outcome that preserves the best opposite move's own exit margin, own future buffer, and remaining suit-token count.

knownBadActions.note: The opposite trick result is strategically incorrect.
